title: LlmBrowserTask
description: One LLM invocation in the browser->primitive pipeline: classify a captured surface, propose an architecture, plan a browser action sequence, decompose a workflow into components, generate a candidate schema, or generate a candidate verifier. The model reads HANDLES/DIGESTS (input_refs), never raw page bodies or secrets. LLM output is ALWAYS untrusted=true — it is a candidate proposal a deterministic gate must validate, never served truth. Owner rule: local models first (localhost:8000 OpenAI-compat / OpenWebUI); cloud only with configured keys. candidate; serves_truth=false.

task_type.description: classify a surface | propose an architecture | plan a browser action sequence | decompose into components | generate a candidate schema | generate a candidate verifier

input_refs.description: handles/digests the model reads (dom_hash, source_hash, artifact_id, receipt command_id) — NEVER a raw page body or a secret

base_url_redacted.description: host only; any embedded key is redacted

local_first.description: true when a local endpoint was tried before any cloud lane (owner rule)

key_ref.description: env:// / file reference to the key; never an inline secret

structured_output.description: the model's parsed JSON result (the candidate proposal)

validation_errors.description: schema/gate violations found when validating structured_output; a non-empty list keeps the proposal blocked

untrusted.description: LLM output is never truth — a deterministic gate must validate it before any promotion
